caption:
Claude Duet: Anthropic's new agent that keeps working when you step away.
Anthropic says it finds the Gmail and Slack messages you've missed and helps you reply, and before it sends a message, makes a payment, signs a document or deletes anything, it waits for your approval. Research preview from 21 October 2026: US Pro and Max only, by waitlist. Sources: claude.com and support.claude.com.
Would you hand it your inbox? 👇
